Never insert or backdate an operation. The existing lagging journals permit testing synchronization without rewriting history. 3. **Exercise the complete paid Invocation producer.** Verify its actual Action, 3 RP, 2 Conviction, shared healing draw, capped healing, target-journal synchronization, qualified cure, exact ended application and Ferry recharge binding. Direct ledger cure or detached cure authority cannot substitute. Include the proposed nonowner/context denials and unchanged-input checks.

That structural rejection satisfies this supplemental unsupported-state boundary. Do not fabricate uses, timing records, saves or receipts to force replay. If encoding fails, explicitly report that no full save was produced or restored. Raw mechanical results and legitimate component-codec checks remain separate.

5. **Keep authority claims precise.** A subsequent rejected direct producer call proves no repeated staged payment/effect; it does not prove persisted command idempotency. Existing genuine session authority, retry and coherent strict-replay evidence retain those responsibilities.

One chronology precision for the final narrative: admission is **r375**; the guarded companion owning context is **r376**. Both occur at `344081/2`.

This decision relies on the completed read-only review of the staged packet and source, including all **54 archived members, 468 source inputs, 163 command/receipt rows, authenticated 157+6 execution lineage and seven matching restore pairs**. I did not execute C#, PowerShell gameplay or the proposed mechanical control. The completed qualification must **not** be restarted for this allocation decision.

**TAC-10 remains unaccepted.** Execute and retain this supplement, update the explicit allocation, then submit the combined final review. After final acceptance and recorded agreement: **finish TAC-10, then stop.**
